fusions.name: Pasture Cut
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the maximum range of 5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%). Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Stampede Cleave
fusions.desc: A sweeping cleave that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds after it lands.

fusions.name: Warm Clearing
fusions.desc: Clears a patch 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Steady Heat
fusions.desc: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
